ir.title: NiN
ir.coverage_contract: 在明确限定的模型、输入范围和运行模式内，完整覆盖并验证所有分支。任何任意 PyTorch 模型均无 opaque 无法保证：未知自定义算子、外部依赖或动态 Python 行为可能无法从现有证据中还原。

coverage.reason: static dependencies are not execution proof

limitations: Static edges express source dependencies, not observed tensor bindings.
Unresolved calls/loops/external definitions remain explicit opaque boundaries.
Mutation updates proven direct aliases only; views, external aliases and interprocedural effects remain unresolved.
Notebook cells are parsed as data; notebook setup/training cells are never executed.

findings.label: Convolution block
proof: convolution → activation → pooling operand dependency path

limitations: Local dependency patterns do not certify arbitrary-input behavior.
Unknown operations, tuple slots, conditional joins and loop templates remain explicit.
No Q/K/V, complete LSTM, MoE or model-family identity is inferred from names.
